name: How do I choose the right R-value and insulation system for my shop?
description: Match the system to your space usage: basic condensation blankets for unconditioned storage, and higher R-value banded systems for fully climate-controlled shop

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right R-value and insulation system for my shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select your insulation system based on how the space is conditioned, local energy codes, ceiling heights, and budget priorities. If the structure is an unconditioned storage shed, a basic single-layer blanket primarily intended to block condensation dripping may be sufficient. For full-time automotive shops, commercial offices, or conditioned workspaces, invest in a liner system or banding system that accommodates thick fiberglass or rigid boards to reach code-mandated roof and wall R-values.
